source.source_name: Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder API v1 — annual reports (iXBRL)
source.license: Free of charge, no contract — EU high-value datasets. Annual-report document files may carry specific reuse wording — verify.
source.data_freshness: real-time per filing; reported by fiscal year
source.attribution: Confirm document-file reuse terms specifically before redistributing raw report files.

transport.compression: zip (the dokument download is a ZIP containing an iXBRL instance)
transport.record_path: unknown — confirm dokumentlista envelope after credentialed call

auth.token_url: issued at registration — do not hardcode /oauth2/token (probe returned 404)

number_formats: xbrl_decimals_and_scale (read decimals/scale attributes; do not assume integer SEK)
parsing.special: Unzip the document, then parse inline XBRL (iXBRL) with an XBRL parser keyed to the Swedish K2/K3 taxonomies (taxonomier.se). Resolve concept names, period contexts, and currency units from the instance — do not hardcode element names across taxonomy versions.

mapping_rules.financials[].raw: persist the raw parsed iXBRL concept map.

fixture_requirements: K3 full annual report (complete income statement + balance sheet)
report in a non-SEK currency (verify unit handling)
non-calendar fiscal year (period context start/end != Jan-Dec)
company with multiple years of reports (multi-fiscal-year dokumentlista)
malformed/partial iXBRL or unexpected ZIP contents

live_test_plan.smoke: After registering, POST /dokumentlista for a known orgnr, GET /dokument/{id} for the latest annual report, unzip, and parse the iXBRL to confirm concept names, period contexts, and currency units against the K2/K3 taxonomy.
live_test_plan.full: For the orgnr universe (seeded from SCB / enumerated via /organisationer), pull latest report(s) per orgnr behind explicit env gates; cache by orgnr + fiscal year; respect rate limits.

blockers: Requires the same free OAuth2 credentials as bolagsverket_vdm (Kundanmälan). Not obtained — no document retrieved.
Exact dokumentlista/dokument request and response schemas are unverified (OAuth-gated).
iXBRL concept names vary by K2/K3 taxonomy version/year — require a taxonomy-aware XBRL parser, not fixed keys.
Reuse/redistribution terms for the annual-report document files specifically are unconfirmed.
Historical coverage is limited to digitally filed reports; paper-only filings are absent.
